description: Configuration panel remote (JavaScript and CSS assets beside remoteEntry.js) on signalk-nearlcrews-ui 0.14.0, measured at gzip level 9 the way snui-check-consumer measures it. Lowered from 46490 bytes, the 0.11.1 figure, when the panel moved to 0.14.0: the release compacts its shipped style text, which more than pays for the additions. Re-record deliberately after reviewing what changed, so the percentage gate catches unexpected growth rather than a library upgrade.
